findings.claim: Exploratory replay shows the B failure 'comes from diverging trajectories'
findings.evidence: Replay verified: 2931 systems (S run 1443, P1 run 1488), shipped and P1 kernels exhaust the budget on the same systems (0/0), replay equals the driver, P2 loses 40. But the three B-failing robertson cells are exactly the cells where P1 also takes 2 more attempts (35/37, 34/36, 36/38); with one trajectory per cell the replay cannot show that P1's trajectories are not systematically more exposed to budget-exhausting systems.
findings.correction: Present the replay as kernel-level equivalence only. A switch past the frozen B failure needs its own pre-registered test, for example more trajectories per cell.
